dependency_source_cross_check.comparison: Sets of explicit imported module names; all source import modifiers and metadata flag values included; flags not compared
dependency_source_cross_check.implicit_Init: Lean.Server.collectImports uses headerToImports(includeInit=false); implicit Init is omitted from this name comparison, explicit source imports of Init are included, and the entire official toolchain remains retained
dependency_source_cross_check.limitation: Does not decode or verify .olean/.ir import tables or artifact content/provenance
dependency_source_cross_check.scope: Every visited dependency .ilean node: inside Mathlib plus all cached non-Mathlib roots

identities.semantic_graph_shape: [module,directImports tuples] for ilean; [module,parsed module names] for local/fallback source

limitations: Static import headers only; no complete dynamic/native execution reachability proof.
No deletion authorization and no certified safe reduction manifest.
No guarantee that measured allocated blocks equal reclaimed filesystem capacity.
No compiler/cache execution or content mutation; source/metadata fingerprints checked for changes during read.
All toolchain, non-Mathlib artifacts, source files and other/shared native outputs are retained.
Artifact contents were not rehashed; per-family allocation was inventoried.
Future source/gate/setup changes require re-evaluating roots and closure.
outside_module_list_encoding: UTF-8; lexicographic order; one module per LF-terminated line
root_policy: Retain whole official toolchain and every non-Mathlib artifact; use every cached non-Mathlib module as a conservative graph root.
